title: Video Test Sink
text: Receive continuous video stream data, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Color space} sets Color space; {Frame size} sets the frame dimensions, {Reorder input frame} sets the input frame reorder, {Save data in workspace}, {Variable name} sets the workspace variable name and {View input} displays input in MATLAB. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Save data in workspace
params.values: Save data in workspace off (default) | on

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Workspace variable name simOut (default) | any MATLAB-supported variable name

params.name: View input
params.values: Display input in MATLAB off (default) | on
